title: Degree-zero reduction of canonical homotopy colimits
statement:
Use the universes of [def-coef-complete-algebroid] and the complete, cocomplete model-category, weak-equivalence, cofibrant-object and Reedy terminology of [lem-coef-reedy-model-structure]. A cosimplicial resolution means a Reedy cofibrant functor $A^\bullet:\Delta\to\mathcal M$ whose structure maps are weak equivalences. Its canonical augmentation to $\operatorname{const}(A^0)$ is induced by the unique maps $[n]\to[0]$. Use homotopy colimits of [lem-coef-hocolim-reindexing-zigzags], computed by the colimit of a projectively cofibrant replacement. Let $\mathcal M$ be combinatorial, $D$ a small ordinary category, and $A:D\to\mathcal M^\Delta$ a functor whose values are cosimplicial resolutions. Put $\gamma(d)=A_d^0$ and fix $X\in\mathcal M$. For $n\geq0$, define $I_n$ to have objects $(d,u:A_d^n\to X)$ and arrows $a:d\to e$ satisfying $u'A_a^n=u$. Its value diagram $V_n:I_n\to\mathcal M$ sends $(d,u)$ to $A_d^0$, not to $A_d^n$. The collapse $[n]\to[0]$ gives $i_n:I_0\to I_n$, with $V_ni_n=V_0$. Let $K$ have objects $(d,[n],u:A_d^n\to X)$ and arrows $(a,\alpha):(d,[n],u)\to(e,[m],u')$ with $a:d\to e$, $\alpha:[n]\to[m]$ and $u'A_e(\alpha)A_a^n=u$. Its value diagram is $T(d,[n],u)=A_d^n$. Degree-zero inclusion $i:I_0\to K$ induces a comparison of homotopy colimits. If $(i_n)_*:\operatorname{hocolim}_{I_0}V_0\to\operatorname{hocolim}_{I_n}V_n$ is an isomorphism in the homotopy category for every $n\geq0$, then
$$i_*:\operatorname{hocolim}_{I_0}V_0\longrightarrow\operatorname{hocolim}_K T$$
is an isomorphism there, represented by a weak-equivalence comparison of homotopy colimits. All comparisons respect the augmentation maps to $X$. No fibrancy assumption on $X$ is required.
